title: skills: objectstack-data relationships.md still says the ownership floor binds a predicate write on a writeRequiresMasterRead detail (after #36282)
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5kt9AD1TPLy7Y9oa9D

Filing gate: ② follow-up owed by a landing PR (PR #36282, card #35802, its `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` line). Source: fleet. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Why

PR #36282 builds the maintainer's ruling on #35802 (comment 7073030861, 「A 批量与逐条一致」): on a `controlled_by_parent` detail, a non-delegated predicate update or delete (`multi: true`) no longer keeps the platform ownership floor once the master gate has passed every master the write reaches. The published skill still teaches the old rule.

## Where

`skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md`, the `writeRequiresMasterRead: true` bullet: "The ownership floor (rows you created) still binds predicate and, for both users, on-behalf-of updates and deletes." Once PR #36282 lands, the predicate half is false: a predicate write by a non-delegated caller writes the rows a by-id write of each would write. The on-behalf-of half stays true (ADR-0090 D10, ruling item 3).

## Done when

- The bullet states the ruled rule: predicate updates and deletes match what by-id writes reach for the same caller, all matched rows or none; on-behalf-of keeps both users' floors.
- Any other sentence in `skills/**` that says the floor binds a predicate write on a `controlled_by_parent` detail is corrected the same way (grep `rows you created`, `ownership floor`, `predicate` under `skills/objectstack-data/`).
- The skill's evals still pass.

Land after PR #36282. `domain:skills`.
